content: Now I'll create 4 child beads that decompose this work into focused, achievable tasks:

args.command:
bead create --title "Instrument frame-level heap and handle metrics" --description "Add instrumentation to track heap allocation and handle counts per N frames to detect monotonic growth patterns.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Add frame-level metrics collection for heap size and handle counts
- Log metrics every N frames (configurable, suggest 100-500 frames)
- Store metrics in a structured format suitable for analysis
- Add a simple analysis tool to plot/visualize the metrics over time
- Run a 10-minute session and confirm metrics are captured
- Identify if there is monotonic growth in heap or handles

## Scope
This is instrumentation only. No fixes or changes to the decode path. Focus on gathering data to confirm whether a leak exists and where." --label split-child --priority 1

output: screenferry-33ffefbc

args.command:
bead create --title "Create static image test harness for isolated decode testing" --description "Build a test harness that feeds static images through the decode path to isolate performance characteristics from live camera variability.

## Acceptance Criteria  
- Create test harness that can replay static images through the decoder
- Support batch processing of 1000+ frames from a fixed image source
- Measure and log decode time per frame
- Simulate 'long session' behavior by running for 10+ minutes
- Confirm the harness reproduces consistent baseline decode times
- Document how to run the harness and interpret results

## Scope
Test infrastructure only. This creates a controlled environment to measure decode performance without camera variability, ROI tracking drift, or scene changes." --label split-child --priority 1

output: screenferry-7a1929ee

args.command:
bead create --title "Bisect decode path to isolate degradation source" --description "Run controlled experiments to identify which component in the decode path causes the performance degradation.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Use the static image harness to measure decode performance over time
- Test the decode path in isolation (no camera, no ROI tracking)
- If degradation appears in isolation, progressively add back components to find the culprit
- Test candidates: per-frame allocations, image processing pipeline, ROI tracker state accumulation
- Identify the specific component or code path responsible for the degradation
- Document findings with evidence (metrics, graphs, code references)

## Scope
Investigation and root cause analysis only. No fixes. This bead produces the diagnosis that the next bead will implement." --label split-child --priority 1

output: screenferry-f60398b5

args.command:
bead create --title "Implement and validate fix for decode degradation" --description "Fix the identified performance issue and validate it with long-running tests.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Implement the fix based on findings from the bisect bead
- Fix must address the root cause (leak, GC pressure, or state accumulation)
- Run a 30+ minute session and confirm decode performance remains stable
- Verify p50 decode time does not degrade beyond 10% from baseline
- Verify zero-yield frame rate stays below 10%
- Update/add tests to prevent regression
- Document the fix and validation results

## Scope
Implementation and validation. This bead depends on the bisect bead identifying the root cause." --label split-child --priority 1

output: screenferry-25c5ff81
